verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies interest-bearing accounts. Treasury Prime documents creating and filing a 1099-INT for an account, which presupposes interest is paid, and its book-transfer docs use a checking-to-savings move as an example. Nothing describes the interest feature itself. Missing for 10: explicit interest-bearing account documentation, sweep options, rate mechanics (how rates are set or accrued), disclosure of who keeps the spread between bank, program and customer, and any independent corroboration.
